categoryDescriptions.publishing: Browse by document type, manuscript version, publication venue, and related topics. Research article is a paper type; preprint is a manuscript version; Findings is a publication venue; poster is a presentation format.
categoryDescriptions.training: Start with parameters and forward computation, then distinguish supervision, optimization, training configuration, and model selection.
categoryDescriptions.data: Browse data preparation, splitting, comparisons, and metrics; interpret training performance, test results, and uncertainty separately.
categoryDescriptions.llm: Follow model roles, training, architecture, and generation while distinguishing capabilities, methods, model versions, and licensing.
categoryDescriptions.agents: Explore agent foundations, tools, context, orchestration, evaluation, and applications. Workflows, RAG, and multi-agent collaboration address different aspects of system design.
categoryDescriptions.rl: Start with states, actions, and returns, then study algorithms. Online/offline, on/off-policy, and model-based/model-free describe different dimensions.
categoryDescriptions.robotics: Explore robot tasks, bodies and spatial representations, motion and control, learning, transfer, and sensing. Robot morphology and learning methods are covered separately.
categoryDescriptions.world-model: Move from state and observation prediction to model-based decisions, then examine feedback and errors. Realistic generation does not automatically imply reliable action prediction.
categoryDescriptions.vision: Browse vision tasks, geometry, representations, architectures, and operations; a task is distinct from a model component.
categoryDescriptions.multimodal: Distinguish model scope, connectors, learning methods, tasks, and audio representations; some methods also apply to a single modality.
categoryDescriptions.generation: GAN is a model family, DiT an architecture, DDIM a sampling approach, and text-to-image a task. Browse the different layers of generation.
categoryDescriptions.graph-finance: Graph learning, recommendation, and finance overlap, but not every recommender or financial model uses a GNN.
categoryDescriptions.science: Distinguish scientific questions, computation, experiment selection, and research automation. Prediction, simulation, and experimentally validated discovery differ.
categoryDescriptions.venues: Browse by primary research area, then filter by conference or journal. Scopes can overlap; presenting a journal paper at a conference does not change its publication record.
categoryDescriptions.systems: Explore compute resources and numerical formats, model adaptation, distributed execution, and inference serving. Understand what each technique is designed to do and how it affects memory use, computation, and serving performance.
categoryDescriptions.development: Browse local version control, remote synchronization, collaboration, and runtime environments. Git and GitHub, commit and push, and images and containers are distinct concepts.

publishing.论文与报告类型: Classify documents by their content and contribution: original research, surveys, position papers, and technical reports.
publishing.稿件版本: Distinguish preprints, accepted manuscripts, camera-ready files, and versions of record; a version label is not a quality rating.
publishing.发表渠道与论文集: Understand conferences, journals, workshops, proceedings, and specific publication venues such as Findings.
publishing.会议展示: Understand oral, poster, and spotlight presentations; labels and arrangements depend on the conference.
publishing.审稿流程与规范: Follow peer review, reviews, author responses, and meta-reviews, along with anonymity and conflict-of-interest policies.
publishing.审稿角色与组织: Distinguish the responsibilities of reviewers, area chairs, program committees, and program chairs.
publishing.学术平台: Find platforms for sharing and discovering papers or managing reviews; a hosting platform may differ from the publication venue.
publishing.论文结构与材料: Understand how appendices and supplementary materials provide proofs, experimental details, and other research materials.
publishing.署名与贡献: Understand authorship, first and corresponding authors, and statements of contributor roles.
publishing.检索与标识: Distinguish literature indexes such as SCIE from persistent identifiers such as DOIs.
publishing.期刊与会议评价: Understand venue lists, journal reports, quartiles, and impact factors; these do not directly measure the quality of an individual paper.

training.模型参数: Weights and other parameters shape a model’s computation, even when they are frozen during training.
training.表示与激活: Distinguish representations, computed activation values, and the functions applied to them.
training.前向计算与推理: Understand how models produce outputs and distinguish inference from reasoning.
training.目标与梯度: Objectives define what to optimize; gradients and backpropagation supply information for updates.
training.优化器与学习率: Compare update algorithms and the settings controlling update scale and schedule.
training.训练进度与配置: Distinguish batches, effective batch size, epochs, and optimizer updates.
training.监督信号: Understand supervised, self-supervised, semi-supervised, and active learning through their training signals.
training.迁移与训练策略: Explore how transfer, representation objectives, multiple tasks, and curricula organize learning.
training.模型选择与搜索: Automated hyperparameter and architecture searches still require objectives, validation data, and budgets.
training.保存与恢复: Use checkpoints to record model and training states for loading or resuming.

data.数据材料: Understand datasets, language corpora, and synthetic data as research materials.
data.数据处理: Curate, annotate, filter, and transform examples while keeping inputs and supervision consistent.
data.数据划分与验证: Training fits parameters, validation guides selection, and testing evaluates the final procedure.
data.泛化与误差: Assess how well a model generalizes by comparing its performance on training data, new examples, and shifted distributions.
data.评估可信度: Check leakage and contamination before interpreting results as evidence of the target capability.
data.实验比较: Use explicit baselines, benchmarks, and controlled comparisons to understand gains and failures.
data.不确定性与复现: Distinguish variation in results from predictive uncertainty and preserve reproducibility information.
data.规模与效果: Study how model, data, and compute scale affect results and limit extrapolation.
data.评价指标: Define what a metric measures before choosing a task-specific calculation.
data.分类与排序指标: Classification and retrieval metrics depend on positive classes, thresholds, ranks, and averaging.
data.视觉重叠指标: Region overlap measures geometric matching rather than the entire detection or segmentation task.
data.回归指标: Continuous-value prediction requires explicit error units, scales, and treatment of large errors.
data.语言与代码指标: Text likelihood and candidate code pass rates measure different aspects of performance.

llm.模型定位与适配: Foundation, base, instruction, and reasoning models describe roles that can overlap.
llm.训练阶段与适配: Understand training through data, objectives, and parameter updates; stage names are not universal.
llm.对齐与反馈训练: Distinguish human preferences, AI feedback, verifiable rewards, and their optimization methods.
llm.奖励模型: Reward models can assess complete outcomes or intermediate steps and select candidates.
llm.网络架构与组件: Understand model structure through encoders, decoders, feed-forward layers, and supporting components.
llm.注意力与位置: Understand information access and how visibility and position enter attention computations.
llm.专家与路由: Distinguish the mixture architecture, expert modules, and routing; sparsity depends on the design.
llm.输入与上下文: Tokenization, message formatting, and context capacity shape what the model actually receives.
llm.生成与采样: Distinguish token-selection strategies, randomness controls, and stopping conditions.
llm.提示与推理方法: Examples, reasoning steps, and extra computation change task handling, usually without weight updates.
llm.事实性与依据: Check factual accuracy, faithfulness to supplied material, and whether sources support conclusions.
llm.开放与许可: Downloadable weights and open-source AI are distinct; inspect licenses and released materials.

agents.智能体基础: Understand the roles of agents, workflows, and their execution frameworks.
agents.环境与交互: Describe environments, available information, actions, and interaction records; distinguish states from observations.
agents.工具与执行: Connect external capabilities and handle calls, feedback, retries, and execution loops.
agents.规划与控制: Organize goal-directed steps or motion and adjust execution using constraints and feedback.
agents.上下文与记忆: Manage information visible to the model and records retained across steps or sessions.
agents.检索与知识: Find, rank, and use external knowledge; retrieval augmentation itself does not require an autonomous agent.
agents.编排与多智能体: Distinguish orchestration and routing from delegation and collaboration among multiple agents.
agents.训练与评估: Train agents to make decisions, assign feedback, and verify results; distinguish evaluation scores from actual task completion.
agents.运行边界: Constrain executable operations through isolation, permissions, and source-aware instruction handling.
agents.智能体应用: Distinguish browser, desktop, and coding agents by their environments and tasks.

rl.决策基础: Understand how policies, rewards, and cumulative returns define learning objectives.
rl.环境与交互: Describe environments, available information, actions, and interaction records; distinguish states from observations.
rl.价值与学习: Estimate long-term returns of states and actions and understand how value estimates are updated.
rl.学习设置: Separately check whether new data are collected, which policy generated them, and whether an environment model is used.
rl.探索与奖励设计: Balance exploration and exploitation, design useful feedback, and identify sparse rewards and reward hacking.
rl.算法: Compare value learning, policy optimization, and specific algorithms; an algorithm name does not define its data setting.
rl.训练机制与效率: Organize experience reuse and credit assignment, and compare data needed to reach target performance.

robotics.具身基础: Understand how body morphology and interaction environments shape embodied capabilities.
robotics.机器人任务: Distinguish manipulating objects, moving the body, and navigating to a destination.
robotics.身体与空间: Describe end-effectors, degrees of freedom, and joint and task coordinates.
robotics.运动学与动力学: Distinguish geometric joint-to-pose relationships from motion caused by forces and torques.
robotics.规划与控制: Organize goal-directed steps or motion and adjust execution using constraints and feedback.
robotics.示范与模仿学习: Collect demonstrations and learn behavior; distinguish data collection from learning methods.
robotics.动作模型与表示: Understand vision-language-action interfaces, action outputs, and action-sequence chunking.
robotics.仿真与迁移: Study the gap between training in simulation and deployment in the real world, and how to adapt to changing conditions.
robotics.机器人感知: Obtain body and object information through contact and internal sensors.

world-model.预测基础: Distinguish environment prediction, state transitions, and forward or inverse relations between actions and outcomes.
world-model.状态表示与观测: Distinguish internal state, sensor observations, and probabilistic beliefs about hidden state.
world-model.模型内决策: Compare future actions through model rollouts, planning, and search.
world-model.反馈与误差: Check whether execution uses fresh feedback and how errors accumulate during repeated prediction.

vision.视觉任务: Recognize, locate, and segment image content by the required output.
vision.空间与运动: Estimate depth, pose, and motion with explicit output and coordinate conventions.
vision.视觉表示: Image patches, feature maps, annotations, and ways to learn visual representations.
vision.视觉结构: Backbones, intermediate components, and task heads in visual networks.
vision.视觉算子: Distinguish operations such as convolution and pooling from their parameters and outputs.
vision.检测后处理: Process detection candidates to reduce duplicate predictions.

multimodal.多模态基础: Understand modalities and the scope of vision-language and multimodal language models.
multimodal.模型连接: Encoders and connectors transform representations and connect modalities.
multimodal.对齐、融合与表示学习: Distinguish correspondence, information combination, and representation-learning objectives.
multimodal.多模态任务: Find tasks by the inputs and outputs for answering, recognition, grounding, captioning, or retrieval.
multimodal.语音与音频: Distinguish recognizing spoken words from generating speech from text.
multimodal.音频表示与编解码: Audio tokens are representation units; codecs compress and reconstruct sound.

generation.生成模型家族: Distinguish generative models by probabilistic approach rather than architecture or application.
generation.扩散训练与机制: Understand noising, denoising predictions, and diffusion training objectives.
generation.流模型训练: Learn continuous transport between distributions through velocity fields.
generation.生成表示与结构: Distinguish latent variables, the generation space, and prediction-network architecture.
generation.采样与引导: Choose how to update samples and how strongly conditioning information influences generation.
generation.生成任务与条件: Find tasks by conditions such as text, source images, or masks and the desired output.

graph-finance.图结构与知识表示: Nodes, edges, and knowledge graphs describe how data is organized rather than a training algorithm.
graph-finance.图学习方法与任务: Understand message passing, graph neural networks, and relation prediction.
graph-finance.推荐系统: Distinguish interaction-based collaborative filtering, content-based recommendation, and cold start.
graph-finance.时序数据: Temporal order determines available information; time series extend beyond finance.
graph-finance.金融建模与回测: Understand factors, historical strategy simulation, and information or selection biases.

science.科学建模: Start from scientific questions and distinguish approximation, physical constraints, and inverse design.
science.科学计算: Scientific computation supplies simulations and reference results without necessarily using machine learning.
science.分子与蛋白质: Distinguish molecular representations, physical folding, structure prediction, and docking.
science.实验设计与不确定性: Decide what to measure or test next, and interpret predictive uncertainty.
science.自动化机器学习: Search hyperparameters, architectures, and ML workflows while retaining independent evaluation.
science.形式化证明: Check mathematical derivations using logical rules and proof systems.
science.科研自动化: Automate research or improvement loops while independently validating the results.

venues.人工智能: Venues for broad AI, reasoning, planning, and multi-agent research.
venues.机器学习: Venues for learning theory, algorithms, statistical methods, and reinforcement learning.
venues.计算机视觉: Venues for visual understanding, pattern recognition, and image processing.
venues.自然语言处理: Venues for language technology, computational linguistics, and language resources.
venues.机器人: Venues for robot learning, perception, control, and systems.
venues.多媒体与语音: Venues for multimedia, speech, audio, and related signal-processing research.
venues.检索与数据挖掘: Venues for search, recommendation, knowledge discovery, and data management.
venues.计算机系统: Conferences on operating systems, architecture, parallel computing, and machine-learning systems.
venues.图形学与交互: Venues for computer graphics, content creation, and human-computer interaction.
venues.交叉科学: Venues for medical imaging, computational biology, and interdisciplinary computational science.

systems.GPU 与计算: Understand how GPU platforms, kernels, and memory use affect computation.
systems.数值精度: Distinguish numerical formats such as FP32, FP16, BF16, and FP8 from mixed-precision strategies.
systems.模型压缩: Understand how quantization and pruning change model representations or structure and what their implementations require for speedups.
systems.高效微调: Distinguish parameter-efficient fine-tuning as a family from particular methods such as LoRA and QLoRA.
systems.分布式计算: Compare data, tensor, and pipeline parallelism with training-state sharding.
systems.计算与显存优化: Explore efficient attention and activation recomputation: attention kernels can serve training and inference, while recomputation reduces training memory.
systems.推理执行与服务: Distinguish prefill, decoding, caching, and request scheduling before comparing inference optimizations.
systems.系统指标: Distinguish operation counts, computation rates, latency, and throughput together with their measurement conditions.

development.代码与版本: Understand what Git repositories, staging areas, commits, branches, and tags represent.
development.远程同步: Distinguish how clone, fetch, pull, and push affect local and remote repositories.
development.协作与发布: Understand the collaboration roles of GitHub, forks, pull requests, issues, and releases.
development.运行与安装: Distinguish dependencies, Python environments, container tools, images, and container instances.
development.接口与远程操作: Distinguish command-line interfaces, programmatic APIs, SDKs, and encrypted remote connections.
